passive.name: Flowing Flame
passive.text: Upon launching a **Quick Assist** or **Perfect Assist**, the equipper's Impact increases by **25/28.75/32.5/36.25/40%** for 8s. When the equipper launches and hits an enemy with a **Basic Attack**, apply **Wilt** to the target for 30s, stacking up to 20 times, repeated triggers reset the duration. When any squad member hits an enemy, for every stack of **Wilt** applied to the target, the CRIT DMG of the **Ice DMG** and **Fire DMG** dealt by that attack increases by **1.5/1.72/1.95/2.17/2.4%**. Only one instance of this effect can exist in the same squad.

passive.name: Watch Your Fingers
passive.text: Upon launching an **Aftershock**, the equipper's **Physical DMG** increases by **15/17.3/19.5/21.8/24%**, and Daze increases by **10/11.5/13/14.5/16%**, lasting 10s.

passive.name: Thick Broth
passive.text: For every 10 Energy accumulated, the equipper's Impact is increased by **2/2.3/2.6/2.9/3.2%**, stacking up to 8 times. After Energy is consumed, this bonus remains for 8 more seconds. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.

passive.name: Passionate Construction
passive.text:
While off-field, the equipper's Energy Regen increases by **0.6/0.75/0.9/1.05/1.2**/s.
When using an **EX Special Attack**, the equipper's Impact is increased by **10/12.5/15/17.5/20%** for 10s, stacking up to 2 times. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.

passive.name: Watch Your Fingers
passive.text: Upon launching an **Aftershock**, the equipper's **Physical DMG** increases by **15/17.3/19.5/21.8/24%**, and Daze increases by **10/11.5/13/14.5/16%**, lasting 10s.

passive.name: Behemoth Hunter
passive.text: When the target's HP is no lower than 50%, the equipper inflicts **10/11.5/13/14.5/16%** more Daze to the target. When the target's HP is no lower than 75%, this bonus is further increased by **10/11.5/13/14.5/16%**.

passive.name: Tsunami
passive.text: The equipper's attacks inflict **8/9/10/11/12%** more Daze on their main target.

passive.name: Fire!
passive.text: The equipper gains 1 Charge stack every 3s, stacking up to 6 times. When launching an **EX Special Attack**, consumes all Charge stacks and each stack consumed increases the skill's Daze inflicted by **4/4.6/5.2/5.8/6.4%**.

skillPriority: Special Attack > Chain Attack > Assist > Basic Attack > Dodge

entries.name: Basic Attack: Swift Strike
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack to activate:
Unleashes up to 3 attacks forward, dealing **Physical DMG**.

entries.name: Basic Attack: Leaping Strike
entries.text:
Hold Basic Attack to activate:
Leap forward and unleash a series of slashes, dealing **Physical DMG**.

entries.name: Dodge: Reversal Shot
entries.text:
Press Dodge to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Dash Attack: First Strike Advantage
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack during a dodge to activate:
Dash forward and slash, dealing **Physical DMG**.

entries.name: Dodge Counter: Relentless Retribution
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack during a **Perfect Dodge** to activate:
Thrust at enemies in front, then follow up with a swift slash, dealing **Physical DMG**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Quick Assist: Contract - Bodyguard
entries.text:
When the active character is launched, press Switch to activate:
Thrust at enemies in front, followed by rapid slashes, dealing **Physical DMG**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Evasive Assist: Contract - Outsourced Combat
entries.text:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press Switch to activate:
Dodges the enemy's attack and activates **Vital View**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Assist Follow-Up: Independent Pricing
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack after an **Evasive Assist** to activate:
Leap forward into the air and fire, dealing **Physical DMG**.
Upon activating this skill, consume 1 **Assist Point** to enter the **Hunter's Gait** state.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Special Attack: Rending Claw
entries.text:
Press Special Attack to activate:
Perform a rapid back-and-forth piercing attack, dealing **Physical DMG**.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

entries.name: Special Attack: Rending Claw - Nightmare Shadow
entries.text:
While Pulchra is in the **Hunter's Gait** state, and when another active character in the squad hits an enemy with a heavy attack from a **Special Attack** or **EX Special Attack**:
Dash back-and-forth piercing enemies centered on the target, dealing **Physical DMG**.
After using this skill, if another active character in the squad hits an enemy, Pulchra will repeat the attack up to 5 additional times, with the final attack being a more powerful Finishing Move.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
**Special Attack: Rending Claw - Nightmare Shadow** is an **Aftershock** attack.

entries.name: EX Special Attack: Rending Claw - Flashstep
entries.text:
With enough Energy, press EX Special Attack to activate:
Pierce back and forth times, dealing massive **Physical DMG**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Chain Attack: Hey, Didn't Expect That, Right?
entries.text:
When a **Chain Attack** is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleashes a charged shot forward, dealing massive **Physical DMG**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Ultimate: Oh, Time to Play?
entries.text:
When Decibel Rating is at **Maximum**, press Ultimate to activate:
Unleash a powerful shot at enemies in a large area ahead, dealing massive **Physical DMG**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Core Passive: Hunter's Instinct
entries.text: When Pulchra activates an **EX Special Attack**, **Assist Follow-Up**, **Chain Attack**, or **Ultimate**, she enters the **Hunter's Gait** state, increasing the Daze she deals by **30%** for 6s. After switching to another character, if Pulchra is still in the **Hunter's Gait** state, the state will last until Pulchra switches back in. While in the **Hunter's Gait** state and as the active character, when Pulchra lands a heavy attack on enemies, she can trigger a **Quick Assist** from the previous character in the squad.

entries.name: Additional Ability: Business Partner
entries.text:
When another character in your squad is an **Attack** or **Rupture** character or shares the same Faction:
When Pulchra hits enemies with **Special Attack: Rending Claw - Nightmare Shadow**, **EX Special Attack: Rending Claw - Flashstep**, **Assist Follow-Up: Independent Pricing**, **Chain Attack: Hey, Didn't Expect That, Right?**, or **Ultimate: Oh, Time to Play?**, it applies the **Binding Trap** effect for 15s. After applying **Binding Trap**, all units' **Aftershock** DMG against the target is increased by 30%.

entries.name: Self-Interest
entries.text: When dealing DMG to enemies affected by **Binding Trap**, increase own CRIT Rate by 10%.

entries.name: Opportunistic
entries.text: While in the **Hunter's Gait** state from **Core Passive: Hunter's Instinct**, Pulchra's ATK is increased by an additional 10%.

entries.name: Territorial
entries.text: **Basic Attack**, **Dodge**, **Assist**, **Special Attack**, and **Chain Attack** Lv. +2

entries.name: Joy of the Hunt
entries.text: Reduces Energy Cost of activating **EX Special Attack: Rending Claw - Flashstep** by 5.

entries.name: Tail Game
entries.text: **Basic Attack**, **Dodge**, **Assist**, **Special Attack**, and **Chain Attack** Lv. +2

entries.name: Behind the Mask
entries.text:
**Special Attack: Rending Claw - Nightmare Shadow's** DMG is increased by 15%, and the number of times the repeated attack can trigger is increased by 2.
**Additional Ability: Business Partner**'s **Binding Trap** effect now also applies to all damage types, not just **Aftershock** DMG.
